title: AI media manager - video editor
description:
Dear Professionals,



We are building a team to launch and scale ecommerce stores through direct response advertising, and we are looking for a skilled AI video creator and editor to join us.



Your main task will be to recreate and adapt video ads from American competitors for the Italian market, closely matching their structure, pacing, and visual style.



Our copywriter and creative strategist will provide the translated scripts and creative direction. You will work closely with them, focusing on AI video generation and editing.



We mainly work with simple, long-form video ads. Fast execution, realistic AI content, and consistent quality are our priorities.



What we are looking for



Strong video editing skills and a fast, efficient workflow.



The ability to generate highly realistic AI videos, people, and scenes.



Confidence creating other styles when needed, including cartoons, skeleton animations, and scientific visuals.



Professionalism, reliability, and close collaboration with our creative team.



Tools and growth



We provide xBuild, ChatGPT, Agent, and the additional AI tools needed for the work. You should have your own video editing software and are welcome to integrate your preferred tools.



We value people who take ownership, execute quickly, and want to grow with an ambitious team.



How to apply



Please share relevant video examples, especially realistic AI content you generated and edited yourself. Include your tools, availability, and typical turnaround time for a long-form video ad.



Compensation will be discussed based on your skills, capabilities, availability, and execution speed.



If this sounds like your kind of opportunity, you are more than welcome to apply.



Good luck!



P.S. Share your whatsapp, please.

title: Digital Growth & AI Marketing Specialist
description:
Digital Growth & AI Marketing Specialist



Full-Time | Remote | Up to USD 500/month



We are a small international marketing and branding agency working with multiple brands and industries.



We are looking for a hands-on Digital Growth & AI Marketing Specialist who understands modern marketing, social media growth, lead generation, outreach, performance marketing and AI tools.



You should be comfortable managing multiple brands at the same time and adapting your approach to different audiences, industries and goals.



You must also be able to work with regular overlapping hours with European working hours for communication, coordination and team collaboration.



What You Will Work On



- Social media growth across Instagram,
, LinkedIn, TikTok and YouTube



- Content strategies, hooks and short-form content



- Reels and video editing



- Social media graphics and carousels



- AI-generated images and videos



- Audience and competitor research



- Lead scraping, lead research and prospect list building



- Cold
 and LinkedIn outreach



- AI-assisted outreach and personalisation



- Performance marketing and paid campaigns



- Testing creatives, messaging and audiences



- Marketing automation and AI workflows



- Reporting and analysing what works



- AI & Modern Marketing



- AI should already be part of how you work.



Experience with tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Canva, CapCut, Runway, Kling, Veo, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Apollo, Clay, Sales Navigator or similar tools is valuable.



We want someone who constantly thinks about how AI can help us work faster, smarter and at scale without sacrificing quality.



What We Are Looking For



You should ideally have experience in several of these areas:



- Social media growth



- Content marketing



- Lead generation



- Outreach



- Performance marketing



- AI marketing tools



- Video editing



- Graphic design



- Copywriting



- Marketing automation



You do not need to be an expert in everything!



What matters is that you are hands-on, curious, creative, organised, reliable and able to learn quickly.



A strong understanding of target audiences and how to create content and campaigns that attract their attention is especially important.



Portfolio Required



Please do not apply with only a CV.



We want to see examples of your actual work.



Please include examples such as:



- Social media accounts you have managed



- Growth campaigns



- Reels or short-form videos



- Graphics or content



- Paid advertising campaigns



- Lead generation or outreach campaigns



- AI-generated content or videos



- Marketing automations



Whenever possible, explain:



What was the goal?



What did you personally do?



What was the result?



Concrete numbers and results are highly appreciated.



How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your CV

2. Your portfolio

3. 3 marketing projects or campaigns you are proud of

4. Examples of videos, graphics or social content you created

5. The AI and marketing tools you currently use

6. A short explanation of your experience with lead generation, outreach or paid advertising



Please also answer:



Imagine we give you a local business with almost no social media presence. What would you do during the first 30 days to increase visibility, grow its audience and generate leads?



Important



To show us that you have read the complete job description, please include the word GROWTH somewhere in your application.



Applications without this word may not be considered.



Position Details



Position: Digital Growth & AI Marketing Specialist



Type: Full-Time Remote



Working Hours: Approximately 8 hours per working day



Availability: Regular overlap with European working hours required



Compensation: Up to USD 500 per month



The compensation range is fixed, so please only apply if this matches your expectations.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us long-term and become an important part of how we build modern, AI-supported marketing systems for our agency and our clients.

title: Short-Form Video Editor (Reels / TikTok / Shorts), Health Content
description:
Alpha21 is an online health optimisation coaching business for men over 35. We film a lot of clinical, evidence-led health content. The scripts are written and the footage is filmed. The bottleneck is the edit. We need an editor who turns raw footage into finished, premium reels fast, every day, without being chased, and who gets the science right on screen.



WHAT WINNING LOOKS LIKE: 3 reels live every day.



THE ROLE

- Build up to 21 finished reels a week (3 a day) within your first 30 days

- Source footage: batch-filmed talking-head videos, podcast clips, client results (blood panels before and after, body composition changes)

- Style: tight pacing, clean dynamic captions, B-roll and simple data graphics where they add something. Hook in the first 1–2 seconds, no dead air. Premium and controlled, not meme edits.

- Every reel comes with a brief: the script (with on-screen text, animation cues and shot notes) and a reference video. Match the reference. If you can beat it, send both versions.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Pick up briefs from our Notion content board

- Pull footage from Google Drive, edit, export to spec, upload back to Drive

- Update the card status in Notion so anyone can see where every piece is

- Send first cuts in Slack. Take a note once and apply it everywhere.

- Check every number on screen against the script: marker names, values, units

- Blur names, dates of birth and lab details on blood reports unless the brief confirms consent

- Keep at least 7 days of content ready to post, and tell us before the buffer runs low



YOUR WEEKLY SCORECARD

- Brief to first cut: 48 hours or less

- Revisions: 24 hours or less

- 90%+ of edits approved in the first or second round

- Zero on-screen data errors

- Zero missed deadlines



MUST-HAVES

- A portfolio of edits you did yourself. No portfolio, no interview.

- Speed: you hit the weekly volume without quality dropping

- Strong English. Our content is full of terms like cortisol, insulin resistance and HbA1c. You need to follow the argument so you cut on meaning, not just pauses.

- Accuracy: you check numbers, spellings and units without being asked

- Reliable: you hit deadlines without reminders, and you tell us before you miss one

- Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut, or CapCut if the output is premium

- Working hours that overlap with UK and Dubai business hours (afternoon to late evening Philippine time)

- Comfortable working async in Slack, Notion, Google Drive and Loom



NICE-TO-HAVES

- Motion graphics, thumbnail design, or experience with health/fitness/science content

- You can also edit long-form YouTube. Tell us if that's you.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

- You need a week to make one reel perfect. We ship.

- You wait to be told what's next. The board tells you.

- You take feedback personally. Our feedback is direct.

- You think accuracy is someone else's job.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through this form only. Applications sent only through OnlineJobs.ph will not be reviewed.





Choose "Short-Form Editor" in the form, and have ready:

- 3 to 5 short-form edits you did yourself, and what you did on each

- How many reels a week you can realistically deliver

- Your expected monthly rate

- Your location and time zone



Enter the code word OPTIMISE in the form so we know you read this far. Applications without it will not be reviewed.



OUR PROCESS

1. Portfolio review. We look at the work first.

2. Paid trial edit: raw footage for 5 reels, each with a script and reference video

3. Call with our CEO, Dominic Wenner

4. Offer, then a 30-day trial period against the scorecard

title: Long-Form YouTube & Podcast Video Editor, Health Content
description:
Alpha21 is an online health optimisation coaching business for men over 35. YouTube is our main organic growth channel for the next 12 months, and the editor we hire now builds it with us. The scripts are written and the footage is filmed. The bottleneck is the edit. We need an editor who turns raw footage into clean, premium, accurate YouTube videos every week, without being chased.



WHAT WINNING LOOKS LIKE: 2 YouTube videos live every week.



THE ROLE

- 2 YouTube videos a week, rotating between:

  - Science explainers: our CEO breaks down how the body works (e.g. how high cortisol suppresses testosterone and drives fat storage). Graphics-heavy.

  - Client case studies: interview-style, story-led, built around their blood work and results

  - Straight-to-camera: our CEO on a topic or trend (e.g. TRT, blood testing, training over 40)

- Plus 1 podcast episode a week (video and audio versions) when needed

- Style: clean cuts, retention-focused pacing, captions, lower thirds, zooms, and on-screen graphics that make the science easy to follow (marker values, simple diagrams, cause-and-effect chains). Think Peter Attia or Andrew Huberman's clarity, with the pace of a top YouTube educator.

- Intros cut to our Proof, Promise, Plan structure. Chapters and timestamps on every video.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Pick up briefs from our Notion content board

- Pull footage from Google Drive, edit, export to spec, upload back to Drive

- Update the card status in Notion so anyone can see where every piece is

- Send first cuts in Slack (Loom walkthroughs welcome). Take a note once and apply it everywhere.

- Check every number on screen against the script: marker names, values, units, ranges

- Blur names, dates of birth and lab details on blood reports unless the brief confirms consent

- Keep at least 2 videos ready to post, and tell us before the buffer runs low



YOUR WEEKLY SCORECARD

- Brief to first cut: 72 hours or less

- Revisions: 24 hours or less

- 90%+ of edits approved in the first or second round

- Zero on-screen data errors

- Zero missed deadlines



MUST-HAVES

- A portfolio of edits you did yourself. No portfolio, no interview.

- Speed: you hit the weekly volume without quality dropping

- Strong English. Our content is full of terms like cortisol, insulin resistance, HbA1c and SHBG. You need to follow the argument so you cut on meaning, not just pauses.

- Accuracy: you check numbers, spellings and units without being asked

- Reliable: you hit deadlines without reminders, and you tell us before you miss one

- Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut

- Working hours that overlap with UK and Dubai business hours (afternoon to late evening Philippine time)

- Comfortable working async in Slack, Notion, Google Drive and Loom



NICE-TO-HAVES

- After Effects or motion graphics (data visualisation, simple animated diagrams)

- Thumbnail design

- Experience editing health, fitness, medical or science content

- You can also edit short-form reels. Tell us if that's you.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

- You wait to be told what's next. The board tells you.

- You take feedback personally. Our feedback is direct.

- You want to be the creative director. This is an execution role.

- You think accuracy is someone else's job.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through this form only. Applications sent only through OnlineJobs.ph will not be reviewed.





Choose "Long-Form Editor" in the form, and have ready:

- 1 to 2 long-form edits you did yourself, and what you did on each

- How many long-form videos a week you can realistically deliver

- Your expected monthly rate

- Your location and time zone



Enter the code word OPTIMISE in the form so we know you read this far. Applications without it will not be reviewed.

1. Portfolio review. We look at the work first.

2. Paid trial edit: one YouTube video from raw footage and a brief, including on-screen data graphics from a sample blood panel

3. Call with our CEO, Dominic Wenner

4. Offer, then a 30-day trial period against the scorecard

title: Client Relations & Operations Coordinator

s

Growth Responsibilities

- Project tracking and coordination

- Sales and estimate follow-up

- Researching project and bid opportunities through PlanHub

- Assisting with bid preparation and project documentation

- Creating and updating project drawings using ArcSite

- Supplier and product research

- Additional operational and administrative projects as needed



We want someone who is excited to learn, grow, and take ownership of responsibilities over time.

Tools & Software

- Interested in learning new skills and taking on additional responsibility

- Previous administrative, customer service, office, or virtual assistant experience is preferred



To Apply

2. A brief introduction about yourself and your relevant experience

3. Why you are interested in this position

title: SHOPIFY WEB DEVELOPER + AUTOMATION SPECIALIST
description:
Space Cannon is looking for a reliable Shopify developer for ongoing work across our website, B2B ordering system, affiliate/ambassador programs, and internal automations.



This is not a one-time website build.



Our Shopify store and custom B2B ordering workflow are already built and operating. We need a developer who can learn the existing system, maintain it, make everyday website changes, troubleshoot issues, and continue improving our systems based on real-world use.



We are looking for someone who can become our go-to Shopify developer long term.



WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

Everyday Shopify Development

EXISTING B2B SYSTEM

* Retailer application and approval

* Sales-rep / Dealer ID attribution

* Retailer accounts

* B2B invoicing

* Shipping

* Improving shipping automation

* Adjusting pricing rules

* Improving commission reporting

* Adding new retailer or distributor workflows

* Troubleshooting Draft Orders

* Adding fields, tags, metafields, or automations

* Improving mobile usability



Do not rebuild working systems simply because you would have built them differently.



AFFILIATE / AMBASSADOR SYSTEM



We currently use or expect to expand systems such as UpPromote for affiliate, ambassador, and referral programs.



Projects may include:



* Affiliate commission structures

* Referral commissions

* Discount codes

* Affiliate attribution

* Custom program rules

* Shopify integration

* Reporting

* Payout workflows

* Troubleshooting attribution

* Connecting affiliate information with other internal systems

AUTOMATION + INTEGRATIONS



You should be comfortable connecting Shopify with tools such as:



* Shopify Flow

* Shopify Admin API / GraphQL

* Webhooks

* Zapier

* Make

* UpPromote

* Order Printer Pro

* Google Sheets

*
/notification systems

* Other APIs and SaaS platforms



You do not need to know every platform already.



You do need to be comfortable reading documentation, understanding an existing workflow, and building reliable integrations when required.



THE PERSON WE’RE LOOKING FOR



We want a developer who can handle both:



“Change this section on the website.”



and



“We need to modify the B2B invoice workflow so this happens automatically.”



We do NOT want to hire separate developers every time something changes.



You should be comfortable moving between frontend Shopify work and backend automation/integration work.



REQUIRED SKILLS



Strong experience with:



* Shopify

* Shopify Liquid

* HTML/CSS

* JavaScript

* Shopify apps

* Shopify APIs

* Shopify Flow or comparable automation

* Webhooks/API integrations

* Troubleshooting existing code and workflows

* Mobile/responsive Shopify development



Experience with the following is strongly preferred:



* Shopify Draft Orders

* B2B/wholesale Shopify workflows

* UpPromote

* Order Printer Pro

* Zapier

* Make

* Metafields

* Tags

* Manual payment / ACH workflows

* Sales-rep or affiliate attribution



HOW WE WORK



This will be ongoing hourly work, not a fixed-price website build.



We will communicate requests as they come up.



For larger projects, we expect you to:



1. Understand the request

2. Review the existing system

3. Recommend the simplest reliable solution

4. Give us an estimated number of hours before starting

5. Build and test it

6. Document important changes



For small changes, we want someone who can simply handle them quickly.



We value developers who solve problems without overengineering them.



TO APPLY



Use the subject line:



SPACE CANNON SHOPIFY DEVELOPER



Please answer:



1. How many years have you worked with Shopify?



2. Are you comfortable with both Shopify frontend/Liquid work AND backend/API/automation work?

title: Operations & Client Success Manager

Step 2: Team and Mission

You will work directly alongside our Founder at Prime Home Cleaning Ltd. You will join a mission to alleviate the severe pressures of modern life for dual-income households. Step 3: Culture and Work Ethos

We operate with absolute integrity and zero hidden agendas. We protect our clients' sanctuaries with uncompromising vetting and relentless operational precision. We treat every single clean as a critical mission to restore peace of mind.

Step 4: Candidate Challenge

Do not apply if you are a mercenary simply looking to clock in and collect a paycheck. We are hunting for a true Patriot who is fiercely protective of our 5.0-star reputation and obsessed with flawless execution. Continue reading only if inside you are screaming, "HELL YEAH!"

Step 5: Role Description

a. ROLE TITLE: Operations & Client Success Manager

b. Role Summary:

You will be the operational engine and the absolute frontline of our brand. You will seamlessly merge inbound sales, empathetic customer service, and daily scheduling to ensure our "Safe Hands" promise is never compromised.

c. Mission Alignment:

You propel our mission by converting overwhelmed, skeptical prospects into relieved clients, and by ensuring our housekeeping fleet runs with pinpoint, reliable precision across West Yorkshire.

d. Role Highlights:

• Transforming exhausted prospects into loyal clients by clearly selling the value of our flat-rate "weekend reclamation" packages.

• Masterminding the Jobber scheduling board to ensure flawless daily routing and zero missed cleans.

• Acting as the empathetic, zero-judgement voice of the business when managing client enquiries and acute "mess shame" anxieties.

• Proactively driving our 48-Hour Satisfaction Guarantee, turning potential service corrections into 5-star loyalty.

• Managing the daily support and operational deployment of our strictly vetted primary housekeepers.

• Building bulletproof back-office systems that scale effortlessly with our rapid, intent-driven growth.

Step 6: Candidate Attributes

• Extreme Accountability: You own outcomes entirely. If a schedule breaks or a client is unhappy, you fix it before placing blame.

• Deep Empathy: You listen to the invisible "mental load" our clients carry and respond with total validation and zero judgement.

• Operational Precision: You treat the CRM and scheduling boards as sacred. You do not let small details slip through the cracks.

• Resourcefulness: You solve daily operational fires independently. You find the path when the standard route is blocked.

• Commercial Astuteness: You confidently communicate the value of a £127 flat-rate clean over a £14/hr cash worker without being aggressive.

• Resilience: You maintain a calm, steady demeanour when handling urgent client requests or sudden housekeeper absences.

• Absolute Integrity: You fiercely uphold our stringent vetting and security standards because you understand we are trading in trust.

• Speed: You respond to inbound quote requests and operational bottlenecks with extreme urgency.

• Immaculate Organisation: You naturally systematise chaos. You build structure where others see overwhelm.

• Clear Communication: You write and speak in crisp, reassuring British English, ensuring expectations are set perfectly.

• Radical Humility: You are entirely devoid of ego. You will do whatever dirty work is required to support the team.

• Infectious Drive: You are hungry to grow a 5-star local empire. You view our standard as the baseline, not the finish line.

title: Lightroom Photo Editor - Sports / BJJ Competition Photography
description:
I'm a sports photographer based in Sydney, Australia, shooting Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu competitions and events. Looking for a reliable, detail-oriented photo editor to help with bulk editing of competition galleries in Adobe Lightroom.



THE WORK



Sort/cull raw competition photos down to keepers, then batch-edit to a consistent style using presets I'll provide. Edit order: White Balance, then Exposure, then Tone, then Presence, then HSL, then Detail, then Crop. Typical turnaround is competition shot on a Sunday, full gallery sorted and edited by Thursday. Consistency across a whole gallery matters more than any single perfect photo, this is a clean, true to colour sports editing style, not heavy creative or editorial work. Skin tone and uniform colour accuracy are important since these photos go to paying clients and an online store.



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR



Experience with Lightroom batch editing and presets. Fast, consistent output, able to average around 20 to 30 edited photos per hour once trained on my workflow. Reliable availability around competition weekends, Sunday to Thursday cycle. Comfortable with confidentiality, some galleries involve minors and are not to be shared or retained after delivery.



Happy to run a small paid trial batch first before discussing an ongoing arrangement. Presets and a full style guide provided.

title: UGC Manager (Part-Time, Remote)
description:
We are an 8-figure DTC e-commerce brand running performance-driven advertising campaigns across Meta 
 & Instagram), and we’re looking for a reliable, organized, and proactive UGC Manager to help us scale our creator content operation.



You’ll take ownership of our UGC pipeline — from finding and sourcing creators to managing communication, briefs, deadlines, follow-ups, and final content delivery.



Our primary markets are the United Kingdom and the United States, with additional markets potentially added as we scale.



## What You’ll Do



You’ll own the day-to-day UGC pipeline and make sure creators, briefs, creative strategists, and editors are all moving together.



### Creator Sourcing



* Source UGC creators in the United Kingdom and United States.

* Research and identify creators who fit our target audience, creative requirements, and campaign briefs.

* Build and maintain an organized database of potential creators.

* Vet creators based on content quality, communication, reliability, and suitability for our campaigns.

* Present the strongest creator candidates to our team for approval.

* Continuously build our creator network so we always have new talent available.



### Creator Management



* Handle creator outreach and initial communication.

* Coordinate pricing, deliverables, timelines, and requirements within our guidelines.

* Send creators clear briefs and creative instructions.

* Answer creator questions and make sure they understand exactly what needs to be delivered.

* Track every creator, brief, deadline, and deliverable.

* Follow up consistently before and after deadlines.

* Chase late creators and make sure projects don't get stuck.

* Coordinate revisions when content doesn't meet the brief.

* Make sure final content is delivered correctly and organized for our editing team.



### Internal Team Coordination



* Keep our creative strategists updated on creator progress.

* Coordinate with editors when new footage comes in.

* Maintain a clear overview of which creators are being sourced, contacted, confirmed, filming, overdue, delivered, or requiring revisions.

* Flag problems early rather than allowing deadlines to slip.

title: YouTube Channel Optimiser / YouTube SEO Specialist
description:
Applications close: Monday 24th August 2026 at 9am GMT



Overview

Heads Up is a UK consultancy helping school leaders move their schools from good to great and create excellent schools. We work with Primary, Secondary and Special School headteachers and senior leaders across three areas:

- having difficult conversations with staff

- moving a good school to great

- continuing excellence for heads already leading great schools.



We have an existing YouTube channel with content that isn't currently optimised for discovery or lead generation. We are not looking to create new content at this stage — the priority is making what already exists work harder and to be able to continue to do so as new content is created.



What We Need

A two-month project in three phases:

 

Phase 1 — Audit (Week 1)

— Review the channel and deliver a written audit before making any changes

— Identify which videos have most potential and what's missing

— Give us recommendations, with three priority recommendations

— Analyse traffic source data to understand how people are currently finding the channel — YouTube search, suggested videos, external sources, browse features

— Research what headteachers are actually searching for on YouTube that connects to the problems Heads Up solves, so titles and descriptions in Phase 2 are built on real search behaviour



Phase 2 — Optimisation (Weeks 3–5)

— Rewrite and optimise titles to match real headteacher search behaviour and Heads Up brand voice

— Rewrite and optimise descriptions — first 2–3 lines matter most; include relevant language naturally and in line with current best practice

— Update tags across all videos

— Add captions to every video so they are always present

— Add chapters (named timestamps) to video descriptions to aid navigation and improve search visibility

— Add or update cards and end screens on every video

— Add a like prompt to every video to support the algorithm

— Optimise the channel page and playlist structure around the three Heads Up pathways

— Ensure all links use UTM tracking so email sign-ups from YouTube can be measured in Google Analytics



CTAs — where and what

Every video should have a consistent CTA stack. The primary destination across all placements is the relevant lead magnet or email sign-up. The secondary CTA is always watch next / subscribe.

— End screen (every video) — subscribe button, watch next video, and lead magnet link in the final 5–20 seconds

— Description (every video) — CTA in the first 2–3 lines (visible before “show more”) and again at the end of the full description

— Pinned comment (every video) — pointing to the key resource or next step

— Verbal mention (almost every video) — spoken prompt directing viewers to the link in the description; only omit if the video is very short or the prompt would feel forced

— Card (selective) — pop-up link at a natural moment mid-video; use where content naturally references something, do not force it



Success criteria

1. Every video has an optimised title, description, tags, captions, and a clear CTA

2. Cards and end screens direct viewers to the correct destination, including a ‘watch this next’ recommendation

3. The channel page and playlists are clean and structured around the three Heads Up pathways

4. All links use UTM tracking so email sign-ups from YouTube can be measured in Google Analytics



Phase 3 — One-page handover guide and insights

This phase delivers two things:

1. A reference guide so Heads Up can stay optimised going forward

— What was changed on each video and why

— A simple one-page reference Heads Up can use to maintain best practice going forward

2. Insights that will make future video content itself stronger — better structured, better performing, and easier to optimise from the start

— Audience retention data — at what point do viewers drop off, and what does that tell us about content length and structure in the video itself

— Which videos are performing best and why — topics, titles, format

— Best practice recommendations for future videos, covering both how to optimise a video once it’s live and how to structure content before filming so it performs better from day one

This list is not exhaustive, it is illustrative



How we work and how you’ll be paid

This is a part-time role for up to 2 months. Payment is milestone-based and tied to deliverable approval at each phase — we want someone invested in the quality of the outcome. You will be paid proportionally on satisfactory completion of each phase: the audit, the optimisation, and the handover guide and insights. If we are not satisfied with the quality of a deliverable, we will discuss it with you before proceeding to the next phase.

We are looking for someone who is confident in their work and committed to the outcome. For the right person, there is the possibility of an ongoing part-time role within the business beyond this initial project.





What We'll Provide

— Editor (Limited) access to the YouTube channel

— Our client messaging document

— Our Brand Book so you can retain our brand voice

— Clarity on CTA destinations before Phase 2 begins



What We Won't Provide

— Access to our website backend, Google account, or any other internal systems



Deliverables

Week 1: Written audit — no changes made yet

Week 2: Review and discussion — review audit findings, agree priorities, and confirm CTA destinations before optimisation begins

Weeks 3–5: Full channel optimisation

Week 5: One-page handover guide



Application question

Please send your applications through this online jobs portal by Monday 24th August 2026 9am (GMT).



Heads Up is a UK consultancy helping school leaders move from good to great. We have an existing YouTube channel that isn't yet optimised for discovery.



You have two options — choose one:



Option A: Analyse the Heads Up YouTube channel directly 



Option B: Find a YouTube channel in a professional services or coaching space (any industry) that you think is doing a good job of YouTube SEO



Whichever you choose, answer the following. Maximum 200 words per answer.



1.What is one specific thing being done with titles that helps the channel get found — and what makes it work?

2.What is one thing being done with cards, end screens, or CTAs that keeps viewers engaged or converts them — and why does it work?

3.What is the single biggest discoverability opportunity you can see — and how would you act on it?



Please be specific. Generic answers that could apply to any channel will not be considered. Include the channel name and URL.



Put application number #0005 in the subject line.

title: Personal Brand Video Editor — Daily Short Clips + Weekly YouTube Videos from Recorded Sessions
description:

Short clips (2-3/day): 20-150 second 9:16 clips in a raw, caption-driven style. Reference standard (study before applying):

YouTube videos (2-3/week): 8-20 minute 16:9 edits from the same sessions — one topic per video or several related questions stitched into a themed episode. Same raw style: jump cuts on dead air, occasional punch-ins, on-screen text for key numbers only, simple chapter cards between questions, timestamps in description. 3. Word-synced captions on shorts (bold sans-serif, white with black outline, key words highlighted); light key-phrase text only on longform.

4. Deliver with suggested post captions (shorts) and title options + timestamps (YouTube).



We supply recordings with transcripts and a written style guide.

"Top 10" UFC ranking videos, 100–150 seconds long.

REQUIREMENTS

- CapCut or Premiere Pro

 structure

- Planning
 strategy around launches, promotions and key sales periods

If a workflow isn't converting, I want you to investigate why.

If we're
ing too often, not enough, targeting the wrong segment or missing an opportunity, tell me.

This role is not about sending newsletters for the sake of sending newsletters.

s still need to feel warm, personal and valuable. I don't want every

 campaigns

 design

 strategy for established brands

 to generate sales

 marketing

Tiana

Founder — Lash Me Tee

title: LinkedIn Lead Gen and Copywriting specialist
description:
I'm the owner of DIJKAds, an e-commerce performance growth agency. I'm looking for a hybrid LinkedIn specialist who can handle both manual lead generation and ghostwriting for my personal brand.



About DIJKAds and my ambitions



We are building an agency that helps international e-commerce brands scale. My ambition is to grow this agency significantly over the next few years, and I want to bring people along for the ride. I am not just looking for someone to do a few tasks for a couple of months. I am looking for a long-term team member who wants to be part of a growing business. If you do a great job and help us book calls and write good content, there will be plenty of room for your own career growth and earning potential as the agency scales.



What you will be doing:



- Lead generation: Sending 150 to 200 manual connection requests per week to founders, CMOs, and marketing directors. You will read their profiles to write personalized icebreakers, follow up using my scripts, and log warm leads in a Google Sheet for me to take over. (Approximately 100 conversations per week).

- Content creation: Turning my raw ideas (voice notes and bullet points sent via chat) into structured, highly engaging LinkedIn text posts. You will produce 4-5 posts per week.

- Brand voice and visuals: Studying my backlog of previous posts to accurately match my tone of voice. For some posts, you will also need to create simple accompanying graphics using Canva.



What I expect from you:



- At least 2 years of experience in LinkedIn lead generation and B2B copywriting.

- Advanced English skills. You need to hold natural conversations with prospects in the DMs and write posts that sound like a native speaker wrote them.

- Ability to take a messy "brain dump" and structure it into a compelling story or educational post.

- Basic Canva design skills.

- Availability to work Amsterdam time (CET/CEST).

- A reliable internet setup (minimum 20 Mbps) with a backup power source and backup internet connection.

- This is a part-time role requiring roughly 4 hours per day, 5 days a week (20 hours total per week).

title: Senior Cinematic Video Editor & Motion Designer
description:
## Job overview



We are looking for a genuinely high-level senior video editor and motion designer for a premium, cinematic mini-series in the personal-development space.



This is not standard talking-head or podcast editing. The series needs to feel like a high-end documentary meets a cinematic masterclass: visually bold, emotionally engaging, modern, and highly bingeable.



Depending on your skill set, your work may include editing long-form episodes, building high-end motion graphics and kinetic typography, creating the visual effects to explain discussed concepts, designing transitions, compositing/VFX, and helping create a hero trailer and selected short-form launch clips.



## What we’re looking for



- Expert-level Adobe Premiere Pro skills: long-form editing, story pacing, colour/audio fundamentals, and excellent project organisation.

- Strong After Effects skills: motion graphics, kinetic typography, compositing, visual effects, and custom transitions.

- A portfolio showing cinematic long-form storytelling, premium branded content, documentaries, music videos, narrative YouTube, or similarly high-production work.

- Excellent taste in visual storytelling, pacing, music, sound design, typography, and contemporary design.

- Strong creative judgment: knowing when to use big visual moments and when to let an emotional moment breathe.

- Clear English communication, reliability, and the ability to take direction while bringing strong creative ideas to the table.



Big advantage: 3D, animation, or advanced VFX/compositing experience in Blender, Cinema 4D, Unreal Engine, DaVinci Resolve, or similar. This is not essential if you are exceptional in editing and motion design, but please tell us about it if it is part of your skill set.



## This role is not for you if



Your work relies mainly on repetitive templates, generic social-media edits, auto-captions, or random stock footage. We are not looking for generic visuals, cheesy effects, PowerPoint-style explainers, or fast cutting for the sake of fast cutting.



We want a premium, intentional visual world with editorial taste, strong rhythm, and original ideas.



## What we offer



- A creatively ambitious project with a clear visual direction and strong existing footage library.

- The chance to work on a flagship cinematic series rather than high-volume, templated content.

- Potential for continued full-time long-form YouTube editing work after the project for the right person.



## How to apply



Please send:



1. Your portfolio or showreel, with your 2–3 most relevant examples first.

2. A short note explaining your specific role in each example (editor, motion designer, VFX/compositor, etc.).

3. Your rate expectations or preferred project-pricing structure.

4. Your availability, time zone, and expected AEST overlap.

title: AI Product Builder / Internal Tools Developer
description:
About Us



Bilsmidigt is a Swedish online car dealership based in Stockholm.



We are changing the way people buy and sell used cars by making the process more digital, simple, and convenient. Customers can browse and purchase cars online, have their car delivered to their home, and get a straightforward buying experience without the traditional dealership process.



Behind the scenes, we have a growing team working across sales, purchasing, logistics, workshop, customer service, marketing, and operations.



As we grow, we are building more and more internal tools to make these teams work faster and more efficiently.



That's where you come in.





About the Role



We are looking for a fast, curious, and highly independent AI Product Builder based in the Philippines to join our team full-time.



We build internal tools that help our team work more efficiently. Today, much of the building happens directly through Lovable and Claude, but this has become a bottleneck because too much depends on one person being available to build and iterate on every tool.



We want someone who can take ownership of that work.



You do not need to be a traditional software engineer or have a computer science degree. What matters most is that you are technical enough to understand how things work, comfortable with AI tools, great at problem solving, and able to turn an idea into a working tool quickly.



What You'll Do



You will:



• Build and improve internal tools using Lovable and AI-powered development tools

• Use Claude and other AI tools as part of your everyday workflow

• Take rough business requirements like "We need this process to work like this" and turn them into a working solution

• Ask the right questions when requirements are unclear

• Rapidly prototype, test, iterate, and improve tools

• Troubleshoot issues and fix things when they break

• Test tools from an actual user's perspective before handing them over

• Follow up on tools after launch and improve them based on feedback

• Work closely with our team in Sweden to understand business needs and translate them into practical solutions



How We Work



We value speed, ownership, and iteration.



Five useful iterations in one day are better than spending a week creating the "perfect" plan.



You should be comfortable with:



Build → Test → Get feedback → Improve → Repeat



We don't expect long specifications before starting. We want someone who can look at a problem, understand what we're trying to achieve, build something, and keep improving it.



What We're Looking For



Must have:



• Strong problem-solving skills

• Comfortable learning and using AI tools

• Very comfortable experimenting with new technology

• Fast learner who can figure things out independently

• Strong written English

• Able to understand business needs, not just technical requirements

• Able to work independently without constant supervision

• Good attention to detail

• Comfortable working with a team remotely and communicating primarily through written communication

• Willingness to take ownership of a project from idea through implementation and follow-up



Technical experience is a plus:



• Lovable

• Claude / ChatGPT or other AI development tools

• Basic HTML/CSS/JavaScript

• Databases and SQL

• APIs and integrations

• Git/GitHub

• Supabase

• Automation tools such as Make, Zapier, or similar

• Experience building internal tools, dashboards, workflows, or web applications



A formal developer or computer science degree is not required.



If you've built things yourself, learned technology independently, and can show us what you've made, we'd much rather see that than a degree.



The Ideal Person



You might be a good fit if you are the kind of person who:



• Sees a problem and immediately thinks, "I can probably build something for that."

• Enjoys figuring out how new AI tools work

• Doesn't need everything explained step by step

• Can turn a vague idea into a working prototype

• Isn't afraid of breaking something while experimenting

• Learns quickly from mistakes

• Enjoys building practical things rather than writing code just for the sake of writing code

• Takes ownership instead of waiting for someone to tell you what to do next



Working Hours



-This is a full-time, long-term position.

-You will work with a team based in Sweden, so you need to have good overlap with Swedish office hours (CET/CEST).

-We are looking for someone who can be available for regular communication during overlapping working hours.



Compensation



We are open to discussing compensation with exceptional candidates who bring strong relevant experience.



This is intended to be a long-term position, not a short-term freelance project.



Hiring Process



We want to see how you actually work, not just how good your CV looks.



How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your CV

2. A short introduction about yourself

3. Examples of things you have built (These can be websites, internal tools, automations, dashboards, AI projects, personal projects, or anything else you're proud of).

4. Tell us which AI tools you regularly use (For example: Claude, ChatGPT, Lovable, Cursor, Replit, Bolt, etc.)

5. Tell us about one thing you built that you're particularly proud of. (What was the problem, what did you build, and what tools did you use?)

6. Your expected monthly salary in USD



Please include the word "BUILDER" at the beginning of your application so we know you have read the full job post.



We are looking for someone who wants to build, learn, experiment, and grow with us long-term.



If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Property Development Bookkeeper – AI-Driven
description:
PROPERTY DEVELOPMENT BOOKKEEPER – XERO + AI/AUTOMATION



Location: Remote / Work From Home  

Employment Type: Part-Time / Flexible  

Working Hours: Flexible – no fixed minimum hours, provided bookkeeping is kept fully up to date weekly  

Monthly Rate: £200 per company/director  

Performance Bonus: 5–10% annual performance bonus



About the Role



We are looking for an experienced Property Development Bookkeeper to join our growing property development group and provide dedicated bookkeeping support for multiple companies and SPVs.



This is not a traditional data-entry bookkeeping role.



We are building an AI-driven and highly automated bookkeeping system using Xero and AI/automation tools to reduce manual work, improve accuracy, and create an efficient bookkeeping process across our property development companies.



You will work directly with company directors and external accountants, managing the bookkeeping for assigned companies and ensuring their financial records are accurate, organised and up to date.





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Bookkeeping & Xero

- Maintain accurate bookkeeping for individual companies and SPVs.

- Process and reconcile bank transactions in Xero.

- Manage supplier invoices, expenses and payments.

- Ensure transactions are correctly categorised and allocated.

- Maintain organised digital records of invoices, receipts and supporting documents.



Property Development Accounting

- Track development costs by project, including:

   - Land/property acquisition

   - Construction and contractor costs

   - Professional fees

   - Planning and consultancy fees

   - Finance costs and interest

   - Materials and other development expenses

- Ensure costs are correctly allocated to the relevant company, project and cost category.

- Assist with cash-flow and project-cost reporting.



AI & Automation

- Use AI and automation tools to streamline transaction categorisation, invoice processing, reconciliations and data entry.

- Identify repetitive bookkeeping tasks that can be automated.

- Continuously suggest and implement ways to improve the bookkeeping workflow.



Reporting & Compliance Support

- Prepare regular bookkeeping and management information for each company.

- Monitor and flag unusual transactions, missing invoices and discrepancies.

- Work closely with external accountants to ensure records are complete and accurate for year-end accounts, Corporation Tax and VAT where applicable.





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Required:

- Strong practical experience using Xero.

- Experience managing bookkeeping for multiple companies and/or SPVs.

- Strong understanding of bank reconciliations and management accounts.

- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

- Highly organised and able to manage your own workload independently.

- Comfortable communicating directly with company directors and accountants.

- Comfortable learning and using AI and automation tools.



Highly Preferred:

- Previous bookkeeping experience within property development or construction.

- Experience dealing with development finance, contractors and professional fees.

- Understanding of how property development costs should be tracked by project.

- Prior experience with UK Accounting





WORKING ARRANGEMENT

- This is a flexible, results-focused role. There are no fixed daily working hours or minimum hours. The key requirement is that the bookkeeping for your assigned companies is accurate and fully up to date each week.

- You will attend a weekly meeting every Wednesday at 11:00 AM UK time.

- The structure is designed so that each company director has dedicated bookkeeping support for their respective companies, while following a consistent bookkeeping process across the wider group.



COMPENSATION

The current structure is:

- £200 per month per company director/company portfolio

- There are currently 2 directors, with the potential for the scope to grow as additional companies/SPVs are added.

- 5–10% performance bonus may also be awarded at the end of the year based on performance.



WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

Our objective is not simply to hire someone to manually enter transactions. We want to build a smart, AI-enabled bookkeeping system that reduces repetitive work while maintaining highly accurate financial records across multiple property development companies.



If you are someone who enjoys Xero, property accounting, systems, automation and finding smarter ways to work, this could be a great fit for you.



HOW TO APPLY:

Please send your CV/Resume to saishiv.investments@outlook.com with subject "Property Development Bookkeeper Application"



In your application, please briefly answer the following:

1. How many years of experience do you have using Xero?

2. Do you have experience bookkeeping for property development or construction companies? Please briefly describe.

3. Have you worked with multiple companies/SPVs at the same time?

4. What AI or automation tools have you used for bookkeeping or accounting?

5. What is your expected monthly rate for this role?



Only resumes sent to the above email will be screened. Only qualified applicants will be contacted by email.

title: Construction Website Developer & Local SEO Lead Generation Specialist
description:
We are a growing construction company seeking an experienced website developer and SEO specialist who can build and manage a high-performing website designed to generate qualified calls and estimate requests.



This is not simply a graphic-design position. We need someone who understands construction marketing, local search, conversion optimization, location-based landing pages, content production, keyword strategy, and paid advertising.



## Responsibilities



- Build or substantially improve a fast, professional, mobile-friendly construction website.

- Create search-optimized service pages for offerings such as decks, siding, remodeling, additions, and other construction services.

- Develop unique, geo-targeted pages for the cities, counties, and communities we serve.

- Structure URLs clearly, such as:

 - `/deck-builder/placerville-ca/`

 - `/siding-contractor/south-lake-tahoe-ca/`

 - `/home-remodeling/el-dorado-county-ca/`

- Research how customers search for services—including “deck builder near me,” “siding contractor near me,” and related local-intent searches.

- Publish useful, locally relevant blog content on a daily or agreed-upon schedule.

- Use AI tools to support keyword research, content planning, and production while ensuring everything is accurate, original, useful, and written for real customers.

- Optimize titles, headings, internal links, images, metadata, schema markup, and calls to action.

- Improve our Google Business Profile and coordinate it with the website.

- Build an ethical strategy for earning legitimate reviews, citations, backlinks, and local authority.

- Set up Google Analytics, Google Search Console, call tracking, form tracking, and lead-source reporting.

- Monitor rankings, traffic, calls, estimate requests, and cost per lead.

- Identify and correct technical SEO issues.

- Potentially create and manage Google Ads, Local Services Ads, retargeting, and related campaigns.

- Provide clear monthly reporting that connects marketing work to actual leads and booked projects.



## Required Experience



- Proven experience building websites that rank for competitive local searches.

- Demonstrated results generating leads for construction, roofing, siding, decking, remodeling, landscaping, plumbing, HVAC, or other home-service companies.

- Strong knowledge of local SEO and multi-location website architecture.

- Ability to create location pages without duplicating content or producing low-quality, keyword-stuffed pages.

- Experience with WordPress or another suitable content-management platform.

- Working knowledge of Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Business Profile, keyword-research tools, and call tracking.

- Understanding of conversion-focused website design.

- Ability to write, edit, or manage high-quality SEO content.

- Familiarity with AI-assisted keyword and content workflows.

- Experience running Google Ads or Local Services Ads is strongly preferred.

- Clear written communication and dependable availability.



## Portfolio Requirements



Applicants must provide:



1. At least three websites they personally built or substantially improved.

2. A clear explanation of exactly what they did on each website.

3. Examples of service and location keywords for which those websites currently rank.

4. Evidence of results, such as Google Search Console data, ranking reports, organic traffic growth, calls, form submissions, or booked leads.

5. Contact information for at least one client reference, if available.

6. Examples of construction or home-service content they personally created.

7. Their experience with Google Ads and the approximate budgets they have managed.



Screenshots should conceal confidential client information but must provide enough detail to verify the results. Attractive websites without evidence of rankings or lead generation will not be sufficient.



## First 90-Day Priorities



- Audit our website, competitors, rankings, Google Business Profile, tracking, and existing content.

- Create a keyword map covering every service and target location.

- Establish the website structure and prioritized service-location pages.

- Correct technical, mobile, speed, and conversion problems.

- Improve calls to action, quote forms, trust signals, project galleries, and testimonials.

- Begin publishing optimized service, location, project, and educational content.

- Strengthen local listings, internal linking, schema, reviews, and relevant backlinks.

- Launch or improve paid advertising if the opportunity and budget justify it.

- Report on rankings, qualified traffic, phone calls, estimate requests, advertising costs, and recommended next actions.



## How Success Will Be Measured



Success will be evaluated based on:



- Growth in qualified organic traffic from our service area.

- Improved rankings for service-and-location searches.

- More phone calls and estimate requests.

- Improved conversion rates.

- Increased Google Business Profile visibility.

- Lead quality and booked-job potential.

- Cost per qualified lead from paid advertising.

- Consistent execution and transparent reporting.



No applicant should guarantee a specific number-one ranking. We want a professional who can demonstrate a credible strategy, execute it consistently, and show measurable progress.



## To Apply



Please answer the following questions:



1. Which construction or home-service websites have you personally helped rank?

2. What work did you personally complete on each example?

3. Which local keywords rank, and in which cities?

4. What measurable increase in calls, leads, or booked jobs did your work produce?

5. How would you structure service and location pages for a construction company?

6. How do you prevent geo-targeted pages from becoming duplicate or low-quality content?

7. How would you use AI without publishing generic or inaccurate material?

8. Which tracking systems would you install?

9. What would you prioritize during the first 30 days?

10. What is your pricing, availability, and expected advertising budget?



We may begin with a paid audit or short trial project. The initial assignment will likely involve reviewing the existing website and producing a proposed keyword map, site structure, and sample geo-targeted service page.

s

Reporting & Team Support

WE WANT YOU TO THINK, NOT JUST FOLLOW INSTRUCTIONS

We don't want:

We want:

If an invoice is missing — find out why.



If a task is overdue — don't ignore it.

You will be expected to own your workload.



PERFORMANCE & KPIs



The successful applicant will be measured on performance, reliability and the quality of their work.



Key performance areas will include:



Productivity

Accuracy

Initiative

WORKING ENVIRONMENT

SALARY

We are looking for the right person who can add real value to our business.



APPLICATION PROCESS

PRACTICAL TEST

 to a tenant

THE OPPORTUNITY

title: Experienced Australian Bookkeeper – Xero
description:
Experienced Australian Bookkeeper – Xero



Part-Time | Approx. 10 Hours Per Week | Opportunity to Grow



About Us



Charlotte Piper is a growing Australian-owned chocolate and confectionery manufacturer based in regional Victoria, Australia.



We are a small but growing business supplying customers throughout Australia and New Zealand through wholesale customers, distributors, our online store and other sales platforms.



As our business continues to grow, we are looking for an experienced bookkeeper with previous experience working with Australian businesses to join our team.



This position will initially be approximately 10 hours per week, with the opportunity for the hours and responsibilities to increase for the right person as our business continues to grow.



About the Role



We are looking for someone who can do more than simply enter transactions into Xero.



We want an experienced bookkeeper who can help us keep our accounts accurate and up to date, improve our financial reporting and help us put better bookkeeping, financial systems and processes in place.



You will work directly with the business owner and, where required, alongside our Australian accountant.



Your responsibilities may include:



Managing day-to-day bookkeeping in Xero



Bank and credit card reconciliations



Accounts payable and accounts receivable



Monitoring outstanding customer accounts and supplier invoices



Correctly entering, coding and allocating transactions



Maintaining accurate financial records



Payroll-related bookkeeping and record keeping where required



GST coding



Assisting with information and reconciliations required for BAS



Maintaining accurate records and information for our Australian accountant



Month-end reconciliations and checks



Identifying discrepancies, errors or unusual transactions and bringing these to our attention



Helping improve our bookkeeping procedures and internal financial systems



Producing regular financial and management reports



Assisting with budgets and cash flow reporting



Helping us better understand the financial performance of different areas of our growing business



Reporting & Systems



An important part of this role will be helping us improve the financial reporting and systems within our business.



We don't simply want someone entering information into Xero. We want someone who can help us put processes in place so our financial information is accurate, organised and genuinely useful in making business decisions.



We would like regular reporting that helps us understand areas such as:



Profit & Loss



Cash flow



Accounts receivable and payable



Expenses and changes in costs



Sales performance



Budget versus actual results



Profitability and margins where appropriate



Other financial information or KPIs that would be useful for a growing business



We are looking for someone who is proactive. If you see something that could be improved, a process that could be more efficient or a report that would help us better understand our business, we want you to bring those ideas to us.



Australian Business Experience Is Essential



We are specifically looking for someone who has previous bookkeeping experience working with Australian businesses.



You must have a strong practical understanding of how businesses operate in Australia and be familiar with Australian bookkeeping and taxation requirements, including:



GST and correct GST coding



BAS requirements and preparation support



PAYG and Australian payroll processes



Superannuation



Accounts payable and receivable



Bank and credit card reconciliations



Australian financial record-keeping requirements



Working within Xero for Australian businesses



Preparing accurate financial information and reports for Australian accountants



You will work alongside our Australian accountant where required, so we are not looking for someone to provide legal or specialist tax advice.



What is important is that you already understand the Australian system and know how Australian businesses are required to maintain their financial records and accounts.



Previous bookkeeping experience with Australian businesses is essential.



Xero Experience Is Essential



We use Xero, so strong Xero experience is essential.



You need to be confident working independently within Xero and understand how to keep accounts clean, accurate, correctly coded and properly reconciled.



Experience preparing reports and improving systems within Xero is also important.



Xero certification would be highly regarded.



Please do not apply if you only have basic or limited Xero experience.



English & Communication



You must have excellent written and spoken English.



Because you will be working directly with an Australian business, it is important that you understand Australian terminology, communication and the way Australian businesses operate.



You need to be confident communicating directly with us and asking questions when something doesn't look right or you require further information.



We would much rather you ask a question than make an assumption when dealing with our accounts.



Who We're Looking For



We are looking for someone who:



Has proven bookkeeping experience with Australian businesses



Has strong Xero experience



Understands Australian GST, BAS, PAYG, superannuation and bookkeeping requirements



Has excellent written and spoken English



Has excellent attention to detail



Is highly organised, reliable and consistent



Is honest, trustworthy and understands the importance of confidentiality



Can work independently



Is proactive and uses initiative



Is comfortable identifying and questioning discrepancies



Doesn't simply wait to be told what to do



Can recommend better systems and processes



Can produce clear and useful financial reports



Is comfortable working directly with a business owner



Is interested in understanding our business, not simply processing transactions



Wants to become a long-term member of our team and grow with the business



Hours



This position will initially be approximately 10 hours per week.



We would like some of these hours to overlap with our normal business hours in Victoria, Australia (AEST/AEDT) so we can communicate easily when required.



There is potential for the hours and responsibilities to increase for the right person as the role develops and our business needs continue to grow.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a valued, long-term part of Charlotte Piper and help us build strong bookkeeping, reporting and financial systems as our business continues to grow.

title: Video Editor – NBA Ranking Shorts (YouTube / TikTok) – Paid Per Video, Long-Term
description:
Hi, I'm Joel. I run a group of faceless sports channels on YouTube Shorts and TikTok. My football (soccer) channel does over 100 million views a month. I'm now launching an NBA channel and need an editor who can grow with it.



THE FORMAT

"Top 10" NBA ranking videos, 100–150 seconds long.

Example: "Top 10 Most Disrespectful Dunks in NBA History." The voiceover counts down from #10 to #1 while each clip plays.

I supply the script and the finished voiceover. You find the clips and edit.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Find NBA clips for every ranking in the script (YouTube, highlight sites)

- Cut the clips to match the voiceover beat by beat

- Add the ranking number, player names and on-screen text

- Add sound effects, zooms and fast pacing so viewers don't swipe away

- Deliver 3 videos a day, 7 days a week, once trained



PAY

- $4 per video to start, rising to $6 per video as your quality and speed improve

- At 3 videos a day, that's $360–$540 a month

- Paid monthly. Long-term work.



REQUIREMENTS

- CapCut or Premiere Pro

- It would be best if you have knowledge of basketball or have edited basketball content before

- Consistent. You can deliver 3 videos every day, including weekends.

- Reliable internet and good English

- You can take feedback. A QC lead reviews your edits before they go live.



TO APPLY, SEND:

1. Your portfolio, or 2–3 short-form videos you've edited (basketball edits preferred)

2. A 1-minute video introducing yourself

3. The word BUCKETS at the top of your message. Applications without it won't be read.

title: Software Engineer
description:
About the Role

We're looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer with a front-end focus to join our client's growing engineering team.



This is a hands-on role for an engineer who is comfortable working across the stack and taking ownership of features from start to finish. While the role has a strong front-end focus, we're looking for someone who is comfortable contributing beyond the UI and working across backend services, integrations, and supporting systems.



You'll work closely with Product, Design, and Engineering to turn requirements and ideas into reliable, high-quality software. You'll have the opportunity to contribute not only to how features work, but also to how they look, feel, and work for the end user.



This role is well suited to an engineer who combines strong technical skills with product thinking, design awareness, and good judgement.







Key Responsibilities

Full-Stack Software Development



Design, develop, test, and maintain software across the front-end and backend.

Own features end to end, from understanding requirements and planning through development, testing, deployment, and refinement.

Build reliable, maintainable, and performant software.

Contribute to backend services, APIs, integrations, and supporting systems.

Work closely with Product and Design to translate requirements and concepts into high-quality technical solutions.

Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across the application stack.

Contribute to improving the reliability, performance, and maintainability of existing systems.

Front-End Development & Product Experience



Build polished, intuitive, and responsive user experiences.

Translate UX/UI concepts and mockups into production-ready features.

Apply strong product and design judgement rather than simply implementing designs pixel for pixel.

Identify opportunities to improve usability, clarity, consistency, and the overall user experience.

Make thoughtful improvements while respecting agreed requirements, scope, timelines, and other fixed constraints.

Balance technical quality, user experience, and practical delivery requirements.

Backend & Systems Development



Develop and maintain backend services and supporting systems.

Build and maintain APIs, integrations, scheduled processes, and other technical components as required.

Ensure software is robust, performant, scalable, and maintainable.

Contribute to reliable deployment processes and cloud-based infrastructure.

Investigate and resolve technical issues across the application stack.

Support ongoing improvements to existing systems, processes, and technical workflows.

Product Delivery & Prioritisation



Work with Product, Design, and Engineering stakeholders to understand priorities and deliver against requirements.

Prioritise critical functionality and ensure key requirements are delivered first.

Recognise when additional polish or enhancements can be addressed after core functionality is delivered.

Flag blockers, risks, dependencies, and potential delivery issues early.

Communicate proactively about progress, challenges, and anything that may affect delivery.

Take ownership of assigned features and see them through to completion.

Make practical decisions that balance product quality, technical considerations, and delivery requirements.

Team Collaboration



Participate in planning sessions, code reviews, technical discussions, and other engineering activities.

Collaborate closely with Product and Design to ensure technical solutions meet both functional and user experience requirements.

Share ideas and propose technical improvements to existing systems and workflows.

Contribute to a positive, collaborative, and accountable engineering environment.

Be responsive, reliable, and easy for teammates to work with.

Communicate clearly and respectfully with team members and stakeholders.





Other Responsibilities



Make necessary process suggestions and improvements which can help the team.

Contributes to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed.

Perform other related tasks and duties that may be assigned by the client later on.



About You

We're looking for an engineer who combines strong technical capability with product thinking, design awareness, ownership, and good judgement.



Essential Experience & Skills



2–4 years of professional Software Engineer experience.

Strong full-stack development experience with a front-end leaning.

Solid background in software development and system design.

Experience building and shipping modern web applications.

Experience working across both front-end and backend systems.

Experience working with modern programming languages, cloud infrastructure, and deployment environments.

Experience working closely with Product and Design teams to bring requirements and product ideas to life.

Strong understanding of modern front-end development practices.

Strong attention to detail while maintaining awareness of priorities and delivery requirements.

Ability to own features end to end and work independently.

Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Ability to identify and communicate blockers early.

Product & Design Mindset

What sets the right person apart is a strong product and design eye. You should be able to take a mockup and make it noticeably better instead of copying it pixel for pixel, while still treating copy, legal, scope and deadlines as fixed.



You should understand how to prioritise delivery effectively — shipping what's critical for go-live first and polishing later where appropriate.



You should also be proactive in your communication: flag blockers early and be easy to reach when collaboration or decisions are needed.



Personal Attributes



Product-minded and genuinely interested in how software works and feels for the end user.

Strong eye for detail and quality.

Practical and outcome-focused.

Comfortable making thoughtful decisions when requirements are fixed but there is room to improve the implementation.

Able to distinguish between what is critical for go-live and what can be refined later.

Proactive in raising blockers and risks.

Reliable, responsive, and accountable.

Easy to reach and easy to work with.

Collaborative and respectful when working with Product, Design, and Engineering teammates.

Comfortable working independently while keeping relevant stakeholders informed.

Takes ownership and follows through on commitments.





What You'll Bring



The ideal candidate is a full-stack engineer who leans front-end and enjoys having meaningful ownership over the products they build.



You'll bring strong engineering fundamentals along with an appreciation for product quality and user experience. You won't simply implement a mockup exactly as provided — you'll understand the intent behind it and use your own product and design judgement to make the end result better, while respecting the requirements and constraints that cannot change.



Most importantly, you'll be someone the team can rely on — proactive in communication, quick to flag blockers, easy to reach, accountable for your work, and comfortable taking ownership of a feature from idea through to production.

title: Project & Administrative Assistant
description:
PLEASE READ JOB POST IN ITS ENTIRETY 



Project & Administrative Assistant



We are looking for someone who does more than complete assigned tasks.



We are looking for a responsive, resourceful, and highly organized Project & Administrative Assistant who can work directly with the Founder, support multiple areas of the business, and think beyond what is immediately in front of them.



This role is ideal for someone who naturally asks, “What needs to happen next?”



As you learn the business, we want you to become an extension of the Founder—someone who keeps track of moving pieces, notices what may be missing, follows through, and helps us stay a few steps ahead.



About NSM Consulting Group



NSM Consulting Group is a Washington, DC-based event production and consulting company. We support organizations through the planning and execution of events, programs, trainings, and special projects.



We are a growing small business, which means our needs can change from week to week. We value excellent work, strong communication, resourcefulness, flexibility, and people who take ownership of what they do.



Position Overview



The Project & Administrative Assistant will provide ongoing administrative, project, and event support to the Founder and NSM Consulting Group.



This is a flexible role. You may organize project files, maintain trackers, prepare invoices, conduct research, proofread client materials, prepare meeting resources, or help support a virtual event.



You will receive direction and training, but you will not always receive step-by-step instructions for every assignment. We need someone who can understand the desired outcome, use available resources, think through what may be needed, and ask thoughtful questions when necessary.



As the role develops, responsibilities may evolve based on the needs of the company.



Key Responsibilities



Organize and maintain digital files, folders, documents, and company records.



Maintain project trackers, task lists, deadlines, and follow-up items.



Prepare invoices, receipts, and basic administrative documentation.



Format, proofread, and review
s, presentations, documents, and client-facing materials.



Conduct research and summarize findings clearly.



Prepare materials and resources for meetings, client projects, and events.



Support virtual events, webinars, trainings, and meetings as needed.



Assist with attendee communications, registration lists, surveys, links, presentations, and other event logistics.



Track meeting notes, decisions, action items, and outstanding information.



Follow up on open items without waiting to be reminded.



Identify missing information, potential issues, or next steps and bring them forward proactively.

title: SEO Account Manager
description:
About the role



BUILT is hiring an SEO Account Manager to look after a portfolio of customers and deliver their SEO month after month.



The strategy is already built. Our platform does the research, surfaces suggestions, and gives you a library of actions to choose from. Your job is to take all of that and turn it into a sensible plan for each customer each month, deliver it, see what it did, and adjust.



The other half of the job and honestly the more important half is talking to customers. Explaining what you're doing and why. Answering their questions properly. Making sure they understand the value of the work in plain English, without jargon or waffle. We can teach the SEO. We can't teach someone to be good with people.



What you'll be doing:



- Owning a portfolio of customer accounts and their monthly SEO delivery

- Planning each customer's month: picking the right actions from our list, adding your own where it makes sense, and using the research and suggestions the platform gives you

- Delivering that work to a good standard, on time, every month

- Reading the monthly reports and performance data for each account and working out what's moving the needle and what isn't

- Using what you learn to set the next month's actions, so each account keeps building towards its goals

- Talking directly to customers - updates, questions, the occasional difficult conversation and explaining the work and the thinking behind it clearly

- Educating customers on what SEO is doing for their business, in language they actually use



What we're looking for



**Communication first.** This is the part we won't compromise on:



- Excellent written and spoken English

- Able to explain technical work simply, to business owners who don't know or care about SEO jargon

- Comfortable on a call, confident answering questions on the spot, and honest when something hasn't worked

- Naturally proactive with customers rather than waiting to be chased



**And on the SEO side:**



- Hands-on SEO experience, you've done the work, not just managed it

- Comfortable reading performance data and forming a view from it

- Organised enough to run several accounts at once without anything slipping

- Able to plan a month's work and think a step ahead rather than just clearing a task list

- Happy working inside a defined system and process, and using AI-assisted tools as part of your day



Nice to have:



- Agency or multi-client experience

- Experience working with trades or home services businesses

- Familiarity with the usual SEO reporting tools



What this role isn't



It isn't a strategy role, the strategy is set for you. It isn't a pure execution or publishing role either. It sits in between: you d
 what each customer needs this month within our framework, deliver it, and own the relationship.



This is a remote role, working UK hours.
